name: Final War: Frozen Defense
detailed_description:
In a chaotic Middle-earth, war’s shadow looms over the land, people retreat into castles.

A powerful dark sorcerer has opened the Gates of Hell, summoning a demonic legion.

The balance of magic is crumbling, ancient walls trembling under the infernal onslaught.

Knights! Draw your swords, defend the castle together!

-A New Height in Puzzle Tower Defense

More than a battle of defense and attack, it’s a clash of courage and strategy.

Heroes and towers fuse seamlessly, offering fresh tactical combos and a thrilling combat experience, micro-control RTS hero, strategize like a master, and then embrace the thrill of heroism.

-Expand Territory, build Roads

Expand Territory, then build Roads, road cards help you controlling the enemy’s path to the castle.

Tip: Within your tower's range, the longer the enemy's path, the higher your chances of success.

-Free RTS Battles on the World Map

On a world map, unleash RTS (Real-Time Strategy) battles, leveraging the unique terrain features of each vast region for strategic layouts. Seize resources, engage in real-time combat with countless players, and dominate the battlefield!

-Unite with Players Worldwide

A 3D planetary map hosts players across the globe. Unleash your social savvy, form alliances, grow stronger, and conquer the planet together!

Minimum:
  • OS *: windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 Gen4 or AMD FX 6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750TI
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel i7 Gen7
